phases.label: Evidence
phases.title:
The evidence arrives.
The context doesn’t.
phases.text: A run leaves a trace. A revision changes a step. An investigation begins between files, readings and someone’s notes.

phases.label: Recurrence
phases.title:
The question changes less
than the evidence.
phases.text: Another run, another recipe, another unexpected shift. The details move on. The need to compare, reconstruct and explain returns.

phases.label: The cost
phases.title:
The task is closed.
The reasoning is still fragile.
phases.text: If the method lives only in yesterday’s investigation, the next one begins by rebuilding it. The answer survives. How it was reached is harder to recover.

phases.label: Method
phases.title:
The method must outlast
the investigation.
phases.text: Keep the sequence of checks. Preserve the context. Make the comparison repeatable. A useful response should be available when the question returns.

phases.label: Software
phases.title:
Software gave the method
a life beyond the task.
phases.text: The work established what mattered. Software made those steps inspectable and reusable, without asking memory to hold them together.

phases.label: ARTIFACTS
phases.title:
The work gave
ARTIFACTS its shape.
phases.text: Each practical need extended the system. Sixteen applications now carry those methods into the next run, revision, investigation and review.
